name: Herdr Planner
author: Aleksey Abaydulin
description: Herdr Planner in the bar: counters of threads waiting on you and to review; a click opens a popup with the projects, a project click focuses its herdr workspace.

barWidget.description: Waiting / review counters from the local herdr-planner service (127.0.0.1) and a project popup (attention first, then the planner's groups); hidden while the service does not answer.
